rationale: The previous source uses viewport-fit=cover in26 active native pages, while common header styling reserves only horizontal safe insets. This fails to address the explicit top-cutout requirement. No actual physical cutout failure is observed, so the source observation alone does not establish a major release-blocking risk. Browser-native viewport-fit=contain is a focused correction because the browser fits both layout and100dvh content inside the safe viewport, avoiding a header-only margin that could push bottom controls outside fixed-height layouts. The added normal-flow top inset fallback is0 on ordinary viewports. Physical notch behavior remains unverified.
